recorded_asset_prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original editorial portrait cutout for a culture-magazine cover, photography asset only, no typography. Primary request: create an entirely fictional adult woman in her late thirties with a short dark bob and a thoughtful, quietly confident expression, wearing a beautifully tailored desaturated sage-green jacket over a natural ivory top. Three-quarter seated portrait, head through upper thighs, torso angled gently toward camera, one hand resting naturally near the collar/upper chest as if listening to someone off camera; complete anatomically natural hands, no floating separate hand. Beautiful face with natural skin detail, tiny pores, faint smile lines; no beauty retouch plastic. Premium independent-magazine portrait photography, medium-format film feel, soft large north-window light from camera left, very gentle shadow, subtle warm fine grain. Composition: tall portrait, subject occupies most of the asset height, head with comfortable top breathing room, shoulders and elbows intact, calm sculptural pose, minimal accessories. Isolated on a genuinely transparent background, clean natural hair edges. No text, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no magazine mockup, no copied identity or recognizable celebrity.

stage_prompt_note: The reusable briefs in the README were written later from the design sources. They are not transcripts of historical stage instructions.
